winning_patterns.evidence: Using everyday objects like a phone screen, blocked numbers, tea, or photos creates instant visual and emotional grounding.
winning_patterns.action: Continue rooting emotional hooks in tangible, everyday objects and actions.

weak_patterns.evidence: All videos have single-digit views and 0 engagement, partially due to generic English titles or untargeted upload times.
weak_patterns.action: Adopt Hindi Devnagari script in titles for emotional resonance and test distinct evening posting windows.
